title: Yehudah, Son of Rabbi Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3 mentions his death after seeing Ketev Meriri. Eichah Rabbah, chapter 1, on Galta, has Yehudah bar Rabbi, omitting Shmuel. Shabbat 38a has Rav Yehudah bar Shmuel reporting Rabbi Abba, who reports Rav Kahana, who reports Rav; Dikdukei Soferim instead reads Rabbi Shmuel bar Yehudah.

notes.text: The death anecdote, abbreviated Yehudah bar Rabbi reading and the reversed Shmuel bar Yehudah name are retained as separate textual observations.

The bounded consulted Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3 passage names Yehudah son of Rabbi Shmuel, saying that he saw Ketev, did not fall, and nevertheless died. The exact Dikdukei Soferim reading and Eichah Rabbah omission remain Hyman’s reports here.
